note: Residual pixel differences are font rasterisation. The CSS requests Inter / Segoe UI with no bundled webfont, so the capturing machine's installed font decides the glyphs. Measured here: 4.404 % of pixels differ and the document height shifts by 3 px when the container resolves sans-serif to DejaVu Sans; installing Inter brings the height to an exact match and the difference to 3.330 %. In both cases every band is text, no element moves, and the row bands of non-background content are identical. A genuine layout change would move element boundaries and change the document height - it does not.
